es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Italian Competition Watchdog Launches Suno Investigation ‘Over Unfair Terms,’ Says ‘The Contractual Provisions on Copyright Deserve Particular Attention’
items.summary: La Autoridad Italiana de Competencia ha iniciado una investigación formal contra Suno, el generador de música IA, por supuestos términos contractuales injustos, destacando la necesidad de prestar especial atención a las cláusulas de derechos de autor en sus contratos.

items.title: Sony Music’s AI Slop and Deepfakes Crackdown Intensifies — Soundalike Track Removal Requests Reportedly Top 250,000
items.summary: Sony Music ha intensificado su lucha contra deepfakes y pistas imitativas, enviando más de 250 000 solicitudes de eliminación a distintas plataformas, según un informe del Financial Times que indica más de 260 000 peticiones acumuladas.

items.title: Who Really Wrote Katy Perry’s ‘Hot N Cold’? A Bizarre Twist Could Derail a Dr. Luke Copyright Settlement In South Dakota
items.summary: Un tercero ha solicitado intervenir en el proceso de conciliación del caso de derechos de autor de Dr. Luke, alegando participación en la autoría de ‘Hot N Cold’ de Katy Perry, lo que podría complicar el acuerdo propuesto en Dakota del Sur.

items.title: Major publishers tell US Supreme Court they must intervene in termination rights ruling that “threatens the licensing of copyrighted works throughout the world”
items.summary: Los principales editores musicales y BMG presentaron ante la Corte Suprema de EE. UU. un escrito solicitando intervención en el litigio sobre derechos de terminación que, según ellos, pone en riesgo la licencia de obras protegidas a nivel global.

tip.title: Trabajo por encargo: quién queda como autor se pacta por escrito
tip.body: Si produces para un cliente, define por contrato si cedes derechos, si conservas puntos de producción y si tu nombre aparece en los créditos. Sin contrato, la interpretación depende de la ley de cada país.

en.title: Copyright & Artificial Intelligence News
en.subtitle: Stories published by real industry outlets, each linked to its original article. No invented news.

items.title: Italian Competition Watchdog Launches Suno Investigation ‘Over Unfair Terms,’ Says ‘The Contractual Provisions on Copyright Deserve Particular Attention’
items.summary: The Italian Competition Authority has opened a formal probe into Suno, the AI music generator, alleging unfair contractual terms and emphasizing that copyright provisions in its agreements require particular scrutiny.

items.title: Sony Music’s AI Slop and Deepfakes Crackdown Intensifies — Soundalike Track Removal Requests Reportedly Top 250,000
items.summary: Sony Music is ramping up its crackdown on AI‑generated deepfakes and sound‑alike tracks, having filed over 250,000 takedown requests with various platforms, with the Financial Times reporting more than 260,000 cumulative requests.

items.title: Who Really Wrote Katy Perry’s ‘Hot N Cold’? A Bizarre Twist Could Derail a Dr. Luke Copyright Settlement In South Dakota
items.summary: A third party has filed an intervention in Dr. Luke’s copyright settlement case, claiming an authorship interest in Katy Perry’s ‘Hot N Cold’, a development that could jeopardize the proposed agreement in South Dakota.

items.title: Major publishers tell US Supreme Court they must intervene in termination rights ruling that “threatens the licensing of copyrighted works throughout the world”
items.summary: Major music publishers together with BMG have filed a brief with the U.S. Supreme Court, urging the Court to intervene in the termination‑rights dispute that they say threatens worldwide licensing of copyrighted works.

tip.title: Work for hire: put authorship in writing
tip.body: If you produce for a client, spell out in the contract whether you assign rights, keep producer points, and get credited. Without a contract, the outcome depends on each country's law.
